task1.title: Reasons for choosing a UK university, 1987 vs 2007
task1.prompt: The charts below show the main reasons why students chose a particular university in the UK, in 1987 and 2007.

chartDesc.title: Main reasons for students choosing a particular UK university 1987 / 2007
chartDesc.overview: Suitable degree courses remained the most significant reason for choosing a UK university in both years, while the proportion of students choosing a university based on good sports and social activities dropped significantly by 2007.
keyFeatures: Suitable degree courses was the most popular reason in both 1987 (35%) and 2007 (37%).
Close to parental home saw the largest increase, more than doubling from 10% in 1987 to 22% in 2007.
Good sports and social activities experienced the sharpest decline, falling from 19% in 1987 to just 6% in 2007.
Quality of resources decreased slightly from 21% to 17%, while Quality of teaching rose slightly from 15% to 18%.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.sampleBand7:
The two pie charts compare the main reasons why students in the UK chose a particular university in 1987 and 2007.

Overall, it is clear that suitable degree courses remained the most important factor in both years, while the popularity of good sports and social facilities fell dramatically. In contrast, being close to the parental home became a much more significant consideration.

In 1987, just over a third of students (35%) chose their university because it offered a suitable degree course, and this figure rose slightly to 37% in 2007. The most striking change concerned proximity to home: only 10% of students took this into account in 1987, but the figure more than doubled to 22% twenty years later.

By contrast, the importance of good sports and social activities dropped sharply from 19% to just 6%. There were also smaller changes in the remaining categories: the proportion choosing a university for its quality of resources fell from 21% to 17%, whereas quality of teaching saw a modest rise from 15% to 18%.
task1.uzSampleBand7:
Ikkita doiraviy diagramma Buyuk Britaniyada talabalar 1987 va 2007-yillarda muayyan universitetni tanlashining asosiy sabablarini taqqoslaydi.

Umuman olganda, ayon bo'ladiki, mos ta'lim kurslari har ikkala yilda ham eng muhim omil bo'lib qoldi, yaxshi sport va ijtimoiy imkoniyatlarning ommaviyligi esa keskin kamaydi. Bundan farqli o'laroq, ota-ona uyiga yaqinlik ancha muhimroq mezonga aylandi.

1987-yilda talabalarning uchdan biridan sal ko'prog'i (35%) universitetni mos ta'lim kursini taklif qilgani uchun tanlagan va bu ko'rsatkich 2007-yilda 37% gacha biroz oshdi. Eng ko'zga tashlanadigan o'zgarish uyga yaqinlik bilan bog'liq: 1987-yilda talabalarning atigi 10% buni hisobga oldi, biroq bu raqam yigirma yildan so'ng 22% gacha ikki barobardan ko'proq oshdi.

Aksincha, yaxshi sport va ijtimoiy tadbirlarning ahamiyati 19% dan atigi 6% gacha keskin tushib ketdi. Qolgan toifalarda ham kichikroq o'zgarishlar bo'ldi: universitetni resurslar sifati uchun tanlaganlar ulushi 21% dan 17% ga tushdi, o'qitish sifati bo'yicha esa 15% dan 18% gacha o'rtacha o'sish kuzatildi.

task2.title: Living alone or in small family units in cities
task2.prompt: In many countries today, people in cities either live alone or in small family units rather than in large, extended family groups. Is this a positive or negative trend?
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
task2.sampleBand7:
In many modern cities, people increasingly live alone or in small nuclear families instead of large, extended family groups. In my opinion, although this trend has some benefits, it is on balance a negative development.

On the one hand, there are clear reasons why this change can be seen positively. Living independently gives young people more freedom and privacy, and it allows them to develop important life skills such as cooking and managing money. For example, a young graduate who lives in their own flat quickly learns to be responsible and self-reliant. In addition, smaller households are often more suited to city life, where flats are small and expensive, and living close to work rather than with a large family can save a great deal of time.

On the other hand, I believe the disadvantages outweigh these benefits. When families live apart, elderly relatives may be left without daily support and can suffer from loneliness, which is especially worrying in societies where caring for the elderly has traditionally been a family duty. Children also miss out on the care and cultural knowledge that grandparents provide. Furthermore, people who live alone often feel isolated, which can have a negative impact on their mental health, whereas in extended families members share responsibilities and support one another through difficult times.

In conclusion, while smaller households offer greater independence, the weakening of family support networks is a serious drawback. I therefore feel that this is, on the whole, a negative trend that societies should try to address.
task2.uzSampleBand7:
Ko'plab zamonaviy shaharlarda odamlar tobora yolg'iz yoki kichik yadro (nuklear) oilalarda yashamoqda, katta, keng qamrovli oila guruhlarida emas. Mening fikrimcha, garchi bu tendentsiyaning ba'zi foydalari bo'lsa-da, u pirovardida salbiy hodisadir.

Bir tomondan, bu o'zgarishni ijobiy deb hisoblash uchun aniq sabablar bor. Mustaqil yashash yoshlarga ko'proq erkinlik va shaxsiy hayot beradi hamda ularga ovqat pishirish va pulni boshqarish kabi muhim hayotiy ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirish imkonini beradi. Masalan, o'z kvartirasida yashaydigan yosh bitiruvchi tezda mas'uliyatli va o'ziga ishonadigan bo'lib ulg'ayadi. Bundan tashqari, kichikroq xonadonlar ko'pincha kvartiralar kichik va qimmat bo'lgan shahar hayotiga ko'proq mos keladi, ish joyiga yaqin yashash esa katta oila bilan yashashga qaraganda ancha vaqtni tejaydi.

Boshqa tomondan, men kamchiliklar bu foydalardan ustun keladi deb hisoblayman. Oilalar ajralib yashaganda, keksa qarindoshlar kundalik yordamdan mahrum bo'lishi va yolg'izlikdan aziyat chekishi mumkin, bu ayniqsa keksalarni parvarish qilish an'anaviy ravishda oilaviy burch bo'lgan jamiyatlarda tashvishlidir. Bolalar ham buvi-buvalar beradigan g'amxo'rlik va madaniy bilimlardan mahrum bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, yolg'iz yashaydigan odamlar ko'pincha o'zlarini yakkalangan his qiladi, bu esa ularning ruhiy salomatligiga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin; katta oilalarda esa a'zolar mas'uliyatni bo'lishadi va qiyin damlarda bir-birini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, kichikroq xonadonlar ko'proq mustaqillik bersa-da, oilaviy qo'llab-quvvatlash tarmoqlarining zaiflashuvi jiddiy kamchilikdir. Shuning uchun men bu umuman olganda jamiyatlar hal qilishga harakat qilishi kerak bo'lgan salbiy tendentsiya deb hisoblayman.
